claims.text: Reviewers widely praise the cleaner for effectively cleaning brushes and sponges, often leaving them looking new or revived.
Many reviewers note that only a small amount is needed, making the product last or go a long way.
Several reviewers appreciate that the product is organic and gentle, with some noting no irritation and brushes staying soft.
Some reviewers mention the bottle arrived not completely full.
A few reviewers comment on the scent, describing it as light and pleasant, though one notes a slight tolerable odor.
